metadata.title: How are maths-anxious students identified and what are the key predictors of maths anxiety? Insights gained from PISA results for Korean adolescents

design_fields.q1_rationale: Plausible values are not applicable because the dependent variable is students’ maths anxiety classification, not a cognitive achievement score for which PISA provides plausible values.
design_fields.q2_rationale: Recorded evidence does not explicitly establish an unweighted analysis. Original extraction rationale: The study does not report applying PISA sampling weights or replicate weights in the analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study employs hierarchical general linear models (HGLM), which account for the nested structure of students within schools.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study performs internal validation using a train/test split but does not validate the model on external data.

design_fields._q2_audit: Corrected not_met to not_reported because original rationale reports absence of weight information or an inference, not direct evidence of unweighted analysis; source verification still required.
